login.heading: This one is yours.
login.reassurance: Not a report. Not a form for anyone above you. A quiet place to notice how your week actually went.
login.failed: That ID and password did not match. Please try again.

home.greeting: How are you doing this week?
home.checkInBlurb: {count, plural, one {# short question} other {# short questions}}. Around three minutes. You can stop anywhere and come back.
home.notNow: Not now — we're here whenever you need a moment.
home.checkedInBody: That's this week done. Nothing else is expected of you.
home.transparencyCard: What we can and can't see

checkIn.title: Wellness check
checkIn.intro: A few questions about your week. There are no right answers, and nobody sees your individual replies except your welfare team.
checkIn.leaveForNow: Leave for now — your answers stay
checkIn.thanksBody: No number, no rating — just a note to yourself that this week happened.
checkIn.doneAside: If you'd like to talk to someone, that door is always open — and it's your call, not anyone else's.
checkIn.queued: Saved on your phone. It will be sent when you are back on a network.

journal.title: Journal
journal.prompt: Anything you want to put into words. Nobody reads this but you.
journal.onDevice: Your words stay on this phone. Only a single number leaves it.
journal.emptyTitle: Nothing here yet — and that's fine.
journal.emptyBody: Some people write every week. Some never do. Both are alright.
journal.keepOnPhone: Keep these words on my phone
journal.keepHint: Off by default. Nothing you write is ever sent, either way.
journal.unavailable: This phone cannot do the on-device reading. You can still write, and your words still stay here.
journal.voiceOnDevice: Your voice is turned into words on this phone. The recording is never kept and never sent.
journal.voiceUnsupported: This phone cannot turn speech into words on its own, so voice is off. Typing works exactly the same.
journal.voiceDownload: Download the on-device language pack to use voice
journal.voiceError: The microphone stopped. Nothing was kept — you can try again or type.
journal.errorTitle: We couldn't finish saving that one.
journal.errorBody: Your words are still here on the screen — nothing is lost. Your phone's storage may be full.
journal.historyEmpty: Nothing kept yet. Tick the box above if you want an entry to stay on your phone.

transparency.title: What we can and can't see
transparency.intro: Written plainly, and kept accurate. Every statement here describes what this app actually does today.
transparency.collectedBody: Your weekly check-in answers. If you write or speak, that is read on this phone and only a single number leaves it. Nothing else about what you wrote is sent.
transparency.collectedWearable: The wellness signal is off unless you turn it on, and no wearable is connected to this version yet.
transparency.onDeviceBody: Your written words and your voice. They are never sent anywhere and are never held on a server. If you choose to keep an entry, it is kept only here, on this phone.
transparency.teamBody: When a check-in suggests support might help, a welfare officer can open your individual record. They see it because someone may need to reach out, and a person decides what happens next.
transparency.teamAudit: Every time someone opens your record, that is written down: who looked, and when.
transparency.commanderBody: Group patterns only, and only for groups large enough that no one person stands out. Your own answers are not shown to your chain of command.
transparency.controlsBody: You can turn the wellness signal off at any time and everything here keeps working. Turning it off stops it being used from then on.
transparency.controlsContact: Nothing in this app contacts anyone on your behalf. It does not message your officer, your commander, or your family.
transparency.questionsBody: Ask your welfare officer. You are entitled to know what is held about you.

settings.title: Your controls
settings.biometricBody: From a wearable, if you connect one. Off unless you turn it on, and you can turn it off again whenever you want.
settings.consentOff: Off · you haven't turned this on
settings.clearJournal: Delete my journal from this phone
settings.clearJournalBody: Removes the entries you chose to keep. Check-ins already on their way to your welfare team are left alone. Nobody is notified.
settings.consentFailed: That did not save. Your setting has not changed — please try again.
settings.localHeading: What is stored on this phone
settings.localBody: Anything you chose to keep, and check-ins waiting to be sent. Deleting is immediate and cannot be undone.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: You can keep using the app. Anything you save will be sent when you are back on a network.
offline.syncing: Sending {count, plural, one {# check-in} other {# check-ins}}…

errors.generic: Something did not work. Nothing you entered has been lost.

states.errorBody: Nothing you have written or answered has been lost. Try again, or come back in a moment.
states.notFoundBody: The link may be old. Everything else is where you left it.
